title: BB: fake two-company transfer generator with exact reconciliation
public_pr_body:
Generates deterministic synthetic SliQ exports for two companies, each with 300 customers, suppliers, open jobs, linked POs and invoices plus 200 payments. Includes independent expected penny totals and guarded new-folder-only output. No database, network, input or write mode; rejects overwrite and invalid sizes/flags. Reuses the existing importer, adding no alternative financial write path.

Validation: 94 tests passed (11 generator plus 83 importer/jobs/decisions), zero failed/skipped. TypeScript and changed-file lint passed. Actual offline CLI generation and both dry runs passed: 300 jobs/invoices per company, owed 1935150 and 2025150 pennies. Tests refuse database/network attempts and prove stable repeat plans and different scoped IDs. Full unit/lint runs in progress and will be recorded on tracker.

Assumption: this is fake input generation for an authorised disposable database rehearsal, not authority to populate any database. Real load/retry/RLS is NOT proved; missing 140/141 release prerequisites remain. No SQL, credentials, real exports, docs files, merge, Ready label or deploy.
